messages:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's authz incident — want to capture owners + short timeline for remediation.
maya: Root cause summary: service-token rotation job failed silently due to permission regression, and audit pipeline dropped ~2 hours of events during backfill. Pattern: rotation + audit gaps.
maya: Proposed remediation tracks:
- rotation automation + guardian alerts
- audit ingestion validation + backfill playbook
- token-validation SLO and weekly health check

maya: Action items (owners + due dates):
- devin -> rotation guardian + prometheus metric + alert (due 2026-04-10)
- oliver -> end-to-end audit ingestion verification + backfill query (due 2026-04-06)
- security-eng -> runbook + SLO proposal (due 2026-04-08)

devin: I'll take guardian + metric. Plan: exporter + rule that pages on consecutive rotation failures. PR by mid-week.

devin: alert sketch:
```
# prometheus alert for rotation guardian
expr: increase(service_rotation_failure_total[10m]) > 0
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
```

oliver: I'll investigate the dropped window and assemble a backfill ES query. Also will add an integration test that replays events into the pipeline. Need security-eng to validate fields before backfill.

security-eng: We'll draft the runbook and SLO text. Preliminary SLO suggestion: token-validation success >= 99.95% over 7d. Will post rationale in doc.

infra-bot: Reminder: Weekly remediation standup scheduled Mon 09:00 PT starting 2026-04-13

maya: I'll create tracker tasks and link PRs. Please post status updates here when you close items so we can mark the postmortem as remediated.

devin: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/901 — rotation exporter + alert. PTAL.

oliver: created issue with sample events and pipeline traces: https://redwood-internal/issue/3120. Backfill query draft will be linked there.

security-eng: Runbook draft: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/token-rotation.md — will add SLO section and escalation policy by EOD Thu.

maya: Note on recurrence: this is the fourth token-related event in ~9 months, so adding SLO + automated guardian is high priority. Also recommend monthly audit ingestion smoke test.

devin: will also add a small synthetic job that exercises rotation and emits an audit event to validate the ingestion path.

oliver: pairing with ops to run backfill in staging first. Scheduling for Thu afternoon.

maya: Thanks all — owners, please post a one-line closure message in this thread when done so we can close the postmortem tracker. If anything blocks, escalate to me. :white_check_mark:
